ceiling_formula.verbatim: For calendar year 2026, the amount used under Sec. 42(h)(3)(C)(ii) to calculate the State housing credit ceiling for the low-income housing credit is the greater of (1) $3.416 multiplied by the State population, or (2) $3,953,600.

history.source: Rev. Proc. 2018-22 (revised; original $2.40 bumped by temporary 12.5% increase)

national_authority_2026_derived.ten_year_value: about $11.7 billion over each award's 10-year claim period
national_authority_2026_derived.flag: DERIVED, not an official IRS total. True total is somewhat higher because small states get the $3.95M floor; excludes returned/carryforward credit.

nine_percent.used_for: New construction / substantial rehab that is NOT federally subsidized
nine_percent.floor: Permanently fixed at no less than 9% (Sec. 42(b)(2))

four_percent.used_for: Buildings with other federal subsidy, chiefly tax-exempt private-activity bond financing, and acquisition of existing buildings
four_percent.floor: No less than 4% for buildings placed in service after Dec 31, 2020 (Sec. 42(b)(3); Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021)
four_percent.bond_note: 4% bond deals do NOT draw down the state per-capita ceiling; they run against the separate private-activity-bond volume cap (Sec. 146). A project qualifies if 50% or more of basis is bond-financed.

timeline.extended_use_period: At least 15 more years after the compliance period closes = 30-year minimum affordability (Sec. 42(h)(6)(D))

basis_boost.qct_dda: Buildings in a Qualified Census Tract or Difficult Development Area get eligible basis boosted to 130% (Sec. 42(d)(5)(B))

income_targeting.20_50: 20% or more of units at/below 50% of area median gross income
income_targeting.40_60: 40% or more of units at/below 60% of area median gross income
income_targeting.average_income: 40% or more of units, averaging no more than 60% AMGI across designated 20-80% tiers (added by Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2018)

obbba_2025.law: One Big Beautiful Bill Act, P.L. 119-21, section 70422 (enacted July 4, 2025)
obbba_2025.ceiling_change: Makes the ceiling increase permanent at 12% (multiplier 1.12), replacing the temporary 12.5% that applied only to 2018-2021. Effective for calendar years after Dec 31, 2025 - this is what drives the 2026 jump to $3.416.
obbba_2025.bond_change: Does NOT simply drop the 50% bond test to 25%. It keeps the 50% test and adds an alternative 25% path that requires at least one bond issued after Dec 31, 2025 financing at least 5% of basis. Effective for buildings placed in service in tax years after Dec 31, 2025.
